resources.name: 3d printer
resources.rules:
1. Eye protection and laboratory PPE mandatory at all times.
2. Never cut vinyl, PVC, or unknown synthetic plastics.
3. Stay within arms reach of machine during operation.
4. Clean work bed and vacuum debris upon session end.

resources.name: Industrial Laser Cutter 500W
resources.description: High-precision Boss Laser 500W dual-head CO2 system for sheet acrylic, birch plywood, Delrin, and anodized aluminum etching. Features integrated exhaust blower and fume scrubber.
resources.location: IIT Bombay Makerspace, Main Engineering Block
resources.rules:
1. Eye protection mandatory at all times.
2. Never cut PVC, vinyl, or materials releasing chlorine gas.
3. Stay within arm reach of emergency stop during firing.
4. Clean honeycomb bed and empty tray after every run.
usage_checklist: Chiller water temperature confirmed between 18-22°C
Exhaust ventilation blower switched ON and air intake clear
Honeycomb bed free from debris, slag, and small cutouts
Emergency stop button tested and accessible
Proper protective goggles (OD6+ 10,600nm) donned

resources.name: Monomer Multi-Material 3D Printer
resources.description: Industrial FDM 3D printer with dual direct-drive extruders capable of carbon fiber PEEK, soluble PVA supports, flexible TPU, and ESD-safe filaments with heated chamber.
resources.location: IIT Delhi FabLab, Central Workshop, Bay 2

specs.Filaments: PLA, PETG, ABS, PA-CF, PEEK, TPU

resources.rules:
1. Level the bed before long prints.
2. Only approved filament types in dry boxes.
3. Remove prime towers and scrape bed carefully with plastic tool.
4. Clean nozzle with brass brush when heated.
usage_checklist: Build plate clean and coated with thin layer of release agent if PETG/PEEK
Filament spools properly sealed in drybox with desiccant indicator blue
First layer visual inspection completed before leaving station
Nozzle wipe bucket emptied

resources.name: Bio-Inoculation Incubator & Shaker
resources.description: Precision CO2 incubator with orbital shaking platform for microbial cell growth, enzymatic assays, and tissue culture expansion. Requires lab manager check-in on arrival.
resources.location: IISc Bangalore Bioscience Center, Block B
resources.rules:
1. Biosafety Level 1 protocols apply strictly.
2. Personal Protective Equipment (lab coat, nitrile gloves, safety glasses) mandatory.
3. Disinfect chamber before and after use with 70% ethanol.
4. Log all biological specimens in the facility safety book.
usage_checklist: Gloves, lab coat, and eye protection donned
Interior shelves wiped down with 70% isopropanol
CO2 tank pressure gauge in normal green zone (>500 psi)
Vessel lids securely taped or clamped to prevent spillage

resources.name: High-Speed Spectral Imager
resources.description: Multi-band hyperspectral confocal imaging system with cryo-cooled CCD sensor for crystal surface inspection and thin-film defect mapping. Currently scheduled for routine laser diode realignment.

specs.Frame Rate: Up to 1200 fps at full ROI

resources.rules:
1. No external USB keys allowed on the acquisition workstation.
2. Clean immersion oil off lenses with lens paper only (never Kimwipes).
3. Allow laser warm-up for 20 minutes before taking measurement.
usage_checklist: Darkroom entrance light interlock locked
CCD sensor temperature verified at -70°C on diagnostic readout
Lens tissue checked free of dust before touching optics
Optical calibration standard plate scanned and verified

resources.name: Digital Oscilloscope 4-Channel 1GHz
resources.description: Keysight InfiniVision 4-channel 1GHz mixed-signal oscilloscope with protocol decoders for I2C, SPI, CAN-FD, and USB2.0. Available for student benchwork.
resources.rules:
1. Wear anti-static wrist strap connected to earth ground.
2. Do not exceed ±40V maximum probe input rating.
3. Return all probe ground clips to organizer rack.
usage_checklist: ESD wrist strap ground continuity verified
Probes 1-4 inspected for intact spring clips and grounding leads
Auto-calibration test passed at boot
